newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Plains fed cattle sell $63, 0ff $1 - feedlots.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Plains fed cattle sell $63, 0ff $1 - feedlots.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle sold at $63.00 per cwt in light to moderate volume after midday Tuesday, down $1.00 from last week, feedlot sources said.
About 16,000 head of slaughter steers and heifers that will likely grade choice and select sold in the Texas Panhandle and western Oklahoma area, they said.
In Kansas, about 2,000 to 3,000 head of steers and heifers sold, the feedlot sources said.
